about.title: Chungchang
about.intro: {project} hi peer-to-peer file sem-thamna platform, lo lo turin hmasawnna decentralized technology-a sak a ni. User-tan tih awlsam interface chu architecture decentralized pumhlum nen a inkawpkhawm a, central authority a mamawh lova file sem-thamna himhim leh ringawm a tihtling. He project hi open source a ni a, {license} hnuaiah chhuah a ni.

decentralized.title: Network decentralized pumhlum
decentralized.description: Central server a awm lo, failure point pakhat reng a awm lo. User-te chuan content chu mahni inkar lakah an hmu a, an download bawk a, central index, tracker, emaw database an mamawh lo.

accessControl.title: Access control thuvelhna
accessControl.description: Tupawh chuan mahni network leh dan-ah a sak thei a, man pek tul lovin. Network tinah hian user role-te hi ruahmanh a ni: neitu, administrator, publisher, moderator leh nung lakawhtu. Tu pawhin content publish thei, moderate thei leh download thei tih chungchangah hian thuvelhna i nei.

ui.title: Tha tak user interface
ui.description: Media center interface fai leh chhanlet thei tak, desktop, TV leh mobile platform-tan ruahman a ni. Keyboard, mouse, gamepad emaw remote control hmangin awlsam takin nawiawmin. User hriatthiam tak chuan command-line interface hmangin headless data server angin software hi an hman thei a ni.

dataFormat.title: Mihring tan chhiar theih data format
dataFormat.description: LISH data format hi JSON-a sak a ni a, siam, chhiar leh hriat awlsam a ni. I content chu metadata fai leh hmuh ngam taka sem ang che, tu pawhin awlsam taka enchhin ngam tur.

security.title: Inbumna leh himna
security.description: Peer-to-peer inbiaknate zawng zawng hi encrypt a ni a, i data hi transit-ah inbumna a ni reng tih a tihtling. User-ten anonymity thar zawk neih nan VPN-a inthup an thei. {project} chuan design atangin i inbumna a zah.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software hi Windows, Linux leh macOS-tan a awm. I duh ber platform-ah han hmang rawh.

download.title: Download
download.description: {project} chu i platform tan la rawh. Download zawng zawng hi free leh open source a ni.
